properties.name: A generated code map is registered in the design as an artifact and linked to what it documents; it is never imported as design content
properties.statement: A project that keeps a generated code-structure graph beside its design (graphify's codegraphs, or any tool's) registers each graph file as an Artifact with a measured checksum, so a regenerated graph reads as a changed file on reconcile. It links each to the design Component for the code it maps (DOCUMENTS), and a design node may name a code-graph node id when it needs to point at specific code. The code map's contents stay in its own file: code structure's home is the code, and a copy inside the design goes stale on every upstream commit (the one-home rule, dec:idea-a-fact-has-one-home-across-a-family-of-designs-and-reflow2-enforces-it). Anthony, 2026-09-23, promoting option (c) of dec:idea-could-a-projects-codegraph-become-part-of-its-reflow2-design. It was applied first in hxm_program as D-0019 (its design node dec:codegraphs-are-linked-to-the-design-not-merged-into-it, commit 5d6f623 on sligara7/hxm_program main): nine graph.json files registered as art:codegraph-<repo>.
